skill.summary: 快速处理各种 Git 指令的技能。适用于：git 操作、代码提交、分支管理、合并冲突、版本回退、远程仓库同步、查看提交历史、撤销修改等场景。触发词：git、提交、推送、拉取、分支、合并、rebase、reset、revert、stash、cherry-pick、tag、diff、log、status。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update: condensed all skill content into a single file with Chinese usage instructions.
- Removed detailed topic files (advanced.md, branching.md, collaboration.md, etc.).
- SKILL.md now provides a concise Git command reference covering common scenarios: commit, branch, merge, rebase, reset, stash, history, remote, tag, and typical safety notes.
- All documentation now in Chinese for easier local reference.
